24:     def support_(self):
25:         check_is_fitted(self, ['svm_estimator_', '_X_fit'])
26:         return getattr(self, "svm_estimator_").support_
27: 
28:     @property
29:     def dual_coef_(self):
30:         check_is_fitted(self, ['svm_estimator_', '_X_fit'])
31:         return getattr(self, "svm_estimator_").dual_coef_
32: 
33:     @property
34:     def coef_(self):
35:         check_is_fitted(self, ['svm_estimator_', '_X_fit'])
36:         return getattr(self, "svm_estimator_").coef_
37: 
38:     @property
39:     def intercept_(self):
40:         check_is_fitted(self, ['svm_estimator_', '_X_fit'])
41:         return getattr(self, "svm_estimator_").intercept_
42: 
43:     def _preprocess_sklearn(self, X, y=None, fit_time=False):
44:         force_all_finite = self.kernel not in VARIABLE_LENGTH_METRICS
45:         if y is None:
46:             X = check_array(X, allow_nd=True,
47:                             force_all_finite=force_all_finite)
48:         else:
49:             X, y = check_X_y(X, y, allow_nd=True,
50:                              force_all_finite=force_all_finite)
51:         X = to_time_series_dataset(X)
52:         nb_features = X.shape[-1]
53: 
54:         if fit_time:
55:             self._X_fit = X
56:             if self.gamma == "auto":
57:                 self.gamma_ = gamma_soft_dtw(X, random_state=self.random_state)
58:             else:
59:                 self.gamma_ = self.gamma
60:             self.classes_ = numpy.unique(y)
61:         else:
62:             check_is_fitted(self, ['svm_estimator_', '_X_fit'])
63:             X = check_dims(
64:                 X,
65:                 X_fit_dims=self._X_fit.shape,
66:                 extend=True,
67:                 check_n_features_only=(self.kernel in VARIABLE_LENGTH_METRICS)
68:             )
69: 
70:         if self.kernel in VARIABLE_LENGTH_METRICS:
71:             assert self.kernel == "gak"
72:             self.estimator_kernel_ = "precomputed"
73:             if fit_time:
74:                 sklearn_X = _cdist_gak(X,
75:                                       sigma=numpy.sqrt(self.gamma_ / 2.),
76:                                       n_jobs=self.n_jobs,
77:                                       verbose=self.verbose)
78:             else:
79:                 sklearn_X = _cdist_gak(X,
80:                                       self._X_fit,
81:                                       sigma=numpy.sqrt(self.gamma_ / 2.),
82:                                       n_jobs=self.n_jobs,
83:                                       verbose=self.verbose)
84: 
85:         else:
86:             self.estimator_kernel_ = self.kernel
87:             sklearn_X = to_sklearn_dataset(X)
88: 
89:         return sklearn_X, y, nb_features
90: 
91:     def _more_tags(self):
92:         tags = super()._more_tags()
93:         sample_weight_failure_msg = "zero sample_weight is not equivalent to removing samples"
94:         tags.update({
95:             "allow_nan": False,
96:             ALLOW_VARIABLE_LENGTH: True,
97:         })
98:         tags["_xfail_checks"].update({
99:             "check_sample_weights_invariance": sample_weight_failure_msg,
100:         })
101:         return tags
102: 
103:     def __sklearn_tags__(self):
104:         tags = super().__sklearn_tags__()
105:         tags.input_tags.allow_nan = False
106:         tags.allow_variable_length = True
107:         return tags
108: 
109: 
110: class TimeSeriesSVC(TimeSeriesSVMMixin, ClassifierMixin, BaseEstimator):
111:     """Time-series specific Support Vector Classifier.
112: 
113:     Parameters
114:     ----------
115:     C : float, optional (default=1.0)
116:         Penalty parameter C of the error term.
117: 
118:     kernel : string, optional (default='gak')
119:          Specifies the kernel type to be used in the algorithm.
120:          It must be one of 'gak' or a kernel accepted by ``sklearn.svm.SVC``.
121:          If none is given, 'gak' will be used. If a callable is given it is
122:          used to pre-compute the kernel matrix from data matrices; that matrix
123:          should be an array of shape ``(n_samples, n_samples)``.
124: 
125:     degree : int, optional (default=3)
126:         Degree of the polynomial kernel function ('poly').
127:         Ignored by all other kernels.
128: 
129:     gamma : float, optional (default='auto')
130:         Kernel coefficient for 'gak', 'rbf', 'poly' and 'sigmoid'.
131:         For 'gak' kernel, a `RuntimeError` is raised at fit time when value is
132:         close to 0 and therefore not compatible with 'gak' kernel.
133: 
134:         If gamma is 'auto' then:
135: 
136:         - for 'gak' kernel, it is computed based on a sampling of the training
137:           set (cf :ref:`tslearn.metrics.gamma_soft_dtw <fun-tslearn.metrics.gamma_soft_dtw>`).
138:           A `RuntimeError` is raised at fit time when computed value is
139:           close to 0 and therefore not compatible with 'gak' kernel.
140: 
141:         - for other kernels (eg. 'rbf'), 1/n_features will be used.
142: 
143:     coef0 : float, optional (default=0.0)
144:         Independent term in kernel function.
145:         It is only significant in 'poly' and 'sigmoid'.
146: 
147:     shrinking : boolean, optional (default=True)
148:         Whether to use the shrinking heuristic.
149: 
150:     probability : boolean, optional (default=False)
151:         Whether to enable probability estimates. This must be enabled prior
152:         to calling `fit`, and will slow down that method.
153:         Also, probability estimates are not guaranteed to match predict output.
154:         See our :ref:`dedicated user guide section <kernels-ml>`
155:         for more details.
156: 
157:     tol : float, optional (default=1e-3)
158:         Tolerance for stopping criterion.
159: 
160:     cache_size : float, optional (default=200.0)
161:         Specify the size of the kernel cache (in MB).
162: 
163:     class_weight : {dict, 'balanced'}, optional
164:         Set the parameter C of class i to class_weight[i]*C for
165:         SVC. If not given, all classes are supposed to have
166:         weight one.
167:         The "balanced" mode uses the values of y to automatically adjust
168:         weights inversely proportional to class frequencies in the input data
169:         as ``n_samples / (n_classes * np.bincount(y))``
170: 
171:     n_jobs : int or None, optional (default=None)
172:         The number of jobs to run in parallel for GAK cross-similarity matrix
173:         computations.
174:         ``None`` means 1 unless in a :obj:`joblib.parallel_backend` context.
175:         ``-1`` means using all processors. See scikit-learns'
176:         `Glossary <https://scikit-learn.org/stable/glossary.html#term-n_jobs>`_
177:         for more details.
178: 
179:     verbose : int, default: 0
